items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I finally got a good man with a big sound named Bob Carroll.

ctx.x: Tab? I'm not sure. But Tab was on alto, but he came to my big band, and he did a good job sitting in Ben's chair playing all the solos that Ben had played and meeting the part.
And something happened -- Tab left and then I finally got a good man with a big sound named Bob Carroll.
Oh yeah, I know Bob Carroll.
